changelog_text:
![KSA Babel · 喵语塔](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-Babel/2ea22506f5c5f29ae60878485875032ce62fe448/docs/branding/ksa-babel-cover-preview-v3.png)

KSA Babel 0.2.2 is the stable software release of the nine-language localization mod for inspected **Windows x64 KSA 2026.10.19.5638** files and **StarMap 0.4.8**. Requires **.NET 10 x64 Runtime**. The mod ID remains `KsaBabel`.

This release moves to the **stable** channel. The existing 0.2.1 release and its testing-channel catalog record are preserved; an indexed version's channel cannot be changed by an ordinary amendment. Plugin, launcher and package metadata are now consistently versioned 0.2.2. Display-patch logic, language-pack content, font, compatibility hashes and profile migration behavior are unchanged.

Choose the appropriate download:

- **KsaBabel-0.2.2.zip** — standard mod package for existing StarMap/Borea installations; no loader or launcher bundled.
- **KsaBabel-0.2.2-5638-Portable.zip** — optional bundled StarMap launcher, extracted into the folder containing KSA.exe.
- The two SHA256SUMS files cover their respective ZIPs; each ZIP also contains a per-file hash manifest.

The nine language options are English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. **Only Simplified Chinese has been personally confirmed by the maintainer.** The seven other non-English translations were produced/reviewed by GPT for KSA using KSP aerospace terminology as reference and still await independent native-speaker review. Some initial Japanese translations came from the credited MIT-licensed KsaUiLanguages project. English uses the game's original text plus the mod's Language menu. A stable software release is not a claim of full-game coverage or completed linguistic review.

For Borea-managed migration, back up the profile, remove the old `KsaChinese` mod from the instance and retain profile data; disabling it alone does not resolve the catalog conflict. Babel refuses activation while the old ID is enabled. Existing `KsaBabel/settings.json` is preserved. Only when new settings do not exist is a valid locale imported from the same profile's old `KsaChinese/settings.json`; saves are not moved automatically.

For a Chinese-focused alternative, [KSA Chinese / KSA-CHINESE](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-CHINESE) remains available separately (ID `KsaChinese`, v0.1.6). Do not enable both mods in one profile.

Validation: rebuilt plugin, launcher and validation program with zero warnings/errors; **1,213 headless checks and 715 target references passed**. Both ZIPs and every payload checksum were verified. The upstream stamper locally produced 0.2.2/stable from the new standard ZIP. Earlier game-window and Borea-component evidence belongs to 0.2.1; this release does not claim another full graphical validation. See the [0.2.2 report](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-Babel/blob/main/reports/0.2.2-%E6%AD%A3%E5%BC%8F%E5%8F%91%E5%B8%83%E4%B8%8E%E9%AA%8C%E8%AF%81.md).

Code and project-authored translations: MIT. Font: OFL-1.1. Bundled StarMap/Harmony retain their MIT notices. Cover artwork has its separate [artwork notice](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-Babel/blob/2ea22506f5c5f29ae60878485875032ce62fe448/docs/branding/ARTWORK-NOTICE.md). No game binaries, complete KSP dictionaries or personal saves are distributed.

SHA-256:

- `KsaBabel-0.2.2.zip`: `1b0f19ffd6996882699e12879ff461fabc96b718d620629136de72f9264b621a`
- `KsaBabel-0.2.2-5638-Portable.zip`: `b548144c19788fb44c7430842c24517e0bebb03dfcb673ac034fc47cf5a06679`

listing.name: KSA Babel / 喵语塔
listing.abstract: Nine-language UI localization for KSA build 5638; native-speaker review pending.
listing.description:
![KSA Babel nine-language cover](ksa-image:cover)

Multilingual display-layer localization for **KSA 2026.10.19.5638 on Windows x64**.

**Translation review:** The maintainer has personally confirmed only the Simplified Chinese translation. Japanese, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese were translated/reviewed by GPT for KSA using KSP aerospace terminology as reference; they have no independent native-speaker sign-off. Some initial Japanese translations came from the credited MIT-licensed KsaUiLanguages project. English mode displays KSA's original English text and retains the mod's added Language menu. The 11 dynamic templates support multilingual composition and original-English fallback; they are not 11 rewritten game texts.

**Chinese-focused alternative:** [KSA Chinese / KSA-CHINESE](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-CHINESE), ID `KsaChinese`, offers English / Simplified Chinese. Its current release is [v0.1.6](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-CHINESE/releases/tag/v0.1.6), standard ZIP `KsaChinese-0.1.6.zip`, for the inspected Windows x64 KSA 2026.10.19.5638 build and StarMap 0.4.8. It has its own [Borea listing](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index/blob/main/listings/KsaChinese.toml). Babel is a separate nine-language localization mod under `KsaBabel`; do not enable both in the same profile.

- Translates supported UI, part and substance captions, tooltips and selected version history.
- Includes a renamed Noto Sans SC font subset and a nine-language menu.
- Seven additional languages each cover 4,786 baseline records plus 11 dynamic templates; AI review is not native-speaker approval.
- Language preferences are saved per game profile, outside the mod files, so Borea instances remain independent.
- Preserves technical identifiers, part/model numbers, units, placeholders and player names.
- Refuses uninspected game/dependency hashes; untranslated text falls back to the original.

This is **partial localization**, not an official translation or a claim of complete coverage. Older version-history text, native library/error text, texture lettering and complete UI/visual coverage remain unfinished. Compatibility with other localization mods has not been established.

Requires .NET 10 x64 Runtime and StarMap 0.4.8. Extract the standard `KsaBabel-0.2.2.zip` into the selected profile's `mods` folder and enable `KsaBabel`. The plugin assembly is KsaBabel.dll. Launch through StarMap/Borea.

For Borea-managed migration, remove KsaChinese from the instance while retaining profile data; disabling it alone does not resolve the catalog conflict. For manual installation, disable KsaChinese before enabling Babel; Babel refuses activation while KsaChinese is enabled. When migrating from the old portable package, first back up its Profile and move the old `<game>/Content/KsaChinese` out of Content. Do not keep both Content/KsaBabel and profile mods/KsaBabel. The standard mod ZIP does not bundle a loader or launcher.

Settings use the current profile's KsaBabel/settings.json. On first startup, only if this new file does not exist, Babel imports a valid locale from the same profile's old KsaChinese/settings.json, without modifying the old file or overwriting existing new settings. No saves are automatically moved and no other profiles are searched. The portable archive is KsaBabel-0.2.2-5638-Portable.zip; its launcher is KsaBabel/KsaBabelLauncher.exe.

Code and translations: MIT, including portions derived from LiX-Works/KsaUiLanguages at b504774158cc03b582a0e75bfe94330cb841f11d. Font: Noto Sans SC subset, OFL-1.1. Original credits and license texts are included.
